approved_scope: Three fixed-checkpoint seed-42 standing noise ablations, 1 env x 6000 steps each; enable velocity telemetry. No repeated baselines or training.
implementation: Existing evaluation.roa_mode=student captures pre-action true/student velocities in m/s, latents and deterministic candidate actions; student action controls environment. No source edit.
noise_removal: Set selected uniform-noise n_min=n_max=0; retain noise term and RNG draw count. Other configured noise unchanged.
telemetry_phase: Diagnostic velocity/action snapshot pre-action; ordinary root telemetry post-step. Use roa_true_velocity_b for same-time estimator error.
tests: Six existing test_roa_evaluation.py tests passed in isaacsim-5.1, including action parity, physical scaling, snapshot immutability and required telemetry.
